description: Defines the QpackBlockingManager class for managing blocked streams and dynamic table entries in QUIC's QPACK implementation.

classes.name: QpackBlockingManager
classes.description: Manages blocked streams and dynamic table entries for QPACK in QUIC.

methods.name: OnHeaderAcknowledgement
methods.description: Handles header acknowledgement on a stream.

methods.name: OnInsertCountIncrement
methods.description: Updates known received count based on insert count increment.

methods.name: OnHeaderBlockSent
methods.description: Records a sent header block with references to dynamic table entries.

methods.name: blocking_allowed_on_stream
methods.description: Checks if more blocking references can be sent on a stream.

methods.name: smallest_blocking_index
methods.description: Returns the smallest index of blocking entries.

methods.name: known_received_count
methods.description: Returns the current known received count.

methods.name: RequiredInsertCount
methods.description: Calculates the required insert count for a set of indices.
